newsitem.title: UK: European cotton markets quiet, in stalemate.
newsitem.headline: European cotton markets quiet, in stalemate.

text.p: Most European raw cotton prices were unchanged in quiet trade on Monday, in advance of Tuesday's crop report from the United States Department of Agriculture, industry sources said.
Sellers remain reluctant to reduce their asking prices, and with no fresh incentive buyers from the spinning sector are not prepared to contract far ahead, they said.
There have been few reports of new business as a result.
